name: @d2p/open-standard-tooling
description: Validation and conformance tooling for the D2P Open Standard (JSON Schema 2020-12).

scripts.conformance: npm run conformance:structural && npm run conformance:referential && npm run conformance:semantic
scripts.oracle:check: node tools/oracle/golden-tshirt.mjs --check && node tools/oracle/golden-tshirt-3d.mjs --check && node tools/oracle/schema-check.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run conformance && npm run fixture:verify && npm run oracle:check && npm test
